game.title: Dark Souls II: Scholar of the First Sin
game.blurb: Action RPG about an Undead searching for a cure in the fallen kingdom of Drangleic, from FromSoftware (published by Bandai Namco), released 2015-04-01. RAWG average playtime: 25 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: From setting out as an Undead to the great foes of Drangleic. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Key Bonfires
chapters.summary: Lighting the bonfires that Steam names: the Sinner's, Iron Keep, Gulch and Brightstone bonfires.

chapters.title: Covenants
chapters.summary: Joining each of the nine covenants and maxing out devotion to one.

chapters.title: People and Side Stories
chapters.summary: Hidden achievements named after people and favours, such as Lucatiel, the smith and the fort.

chapters.title: Weapons, Magic and Gestures
chapters.summary: Reinforcing a weapon to its limit, the Moonlight Greatsword, every gesture, sorcery, miracle, pyromancy and hex.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 335300)
StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Dark_Souls_II
Fandom (darksouls.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://darksouls.fandom.com/wiki/Dark_Souls_II
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has the guide under "Dark Souls II" (completion stage 0); only Controls and Table of Contents subpages exist, and its Walkthrough is linked but not written. There is no separate StrategyWiki page for "Dark Souls II: Scholar of the First Sin" (the base page links to that title, but the API returns no page). darksouls.fandom.com answers the API under "Dark Souls II", with about 35 linked pages, including "Crown of the Sunken King", "Crown of the Old Iron King" and "Crown of the Ivory King" (none of them named in the achievements, so no DLC chapter was made); names only were looked at, nothing copied. 27 of 38 Steam achievements are hidden, and the Steam schema gives hidden ones no description at all, so every hidden one was placed by its name: names ending in "Bonfire" went to the bonfires chapter, names with "Covenant" to covenants, and eight with people or favour names ("Curious Map", "Change of Clothes", "Gathering of Exiles", "Holder of the Fort", "Lucatiel", "Smith for Life", "Garrulous Miser", "Reflections on Disembodiment") to a people chapter; that last grouping is a guess from the names and needs checking. The remaining hidden ones ("King's Ring", "Ancient Dragon", "The Heir", "Last Giant", "Looking Glass Knight", "Vendrick") sit in the main story chapter, with "Self Recollection", "This is Dark Souls" and "The Dark Soul". The Steam schema gives the app no codename (gameName is empty).
